reason: Review server app-service and focused app tests against package guidance.
Verify no hidden scheduler, runtime worker, API route, or executor was added.
Verify repository-only access and no schema changes.
Verify validation errors are stable and redaction-safe.
Verify no raw locators, paths, or payloads are logged or surfaced.
Verify focused check and nextest gates for server behavior.
Verify source hash durable input and request preparation contracts remain separated.
Review job input to source state to in-memory request data flow.
Review constants/helpers are reused rather than duplicated.
